description: Build nextjs-booking-saas starter - Appointments and reservations with Next.js, Auth.js, Prisma/PostgreSQL, Stripe, Google Calendar, and Resend. Must follow Web SaaS blueprint. Create on branch feat/nextjs-booking-saas from current HEAD.
steps: Create and checkout branch feat/nextjs-booking-saas from current HEAD (feat/astro-beginner-static-site)

Create nextjs-booking-saas/ directory with exact-pinned Next.js 15 App Router scaffold (package.json with pnpm 10.x packageManager field, exact versions for next, react, react-dom, typescript, next-auth (Auth.js v5), @auth/prisma-adapter, @prisma/client, prisma, stripe, googleapis, resend, tailwindcss, vitest, fast-check, eslint, eslint-config-next, @types/node, @types/react, @types/react-dom)
Add starter.json matching catalog entry (id:4, folder:nextjs-booking-saas, family:Web SaaS, etc.)
Create domain/entities.ts with Provider, Availability, Booking (state machine: pending/confirmed/cancelled/completed), Payment (state machine: pending/paid/refunded/failed), ProcessedEvent interfaces
Create domain/policies.ts with deny-by-default authorization: provider can manage own availability, customer can book available slots, payment-booking state consistency rules
Create lib/server/config.ts with typed ConfigSpec for AUTH_SECRET, DATABASE_URL, STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET, GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET, RESEND_API_KEY, NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL
Create lib/server/errors.ts (sanitized errors including BookingConflictError for concurrent slots)
Create prisma/schema.prisma with Provider, Availability, Booking, Payment, ProcessedEvent models
Create prisma/migrations/ with initial migration SQL
Create lib/server/auth.ts - Auth.js (next-auth v5) adapter with session/identity extraction

Create lib/server/billing.ts - Stripe payment BillingPort (createCheckoutForBooking, verifyWebhook, handlePaymentEvent) and lib/server/billing-fake.ts with in-memory fake that models payment/booking state binding
Create lib/server/calendar.ts - Google Calendar CalendarPort (createEvent, cancelEvent) and lib/server/calendar-fake.ts
Create lib/server/mail.ts - Resend MailPort (sendBookingConfirmation, sendCancellation) and lib/server/mail-fake.ts
Create lib/server/database.ts - Prisma-based repositories with slot concurrency check (optimistic locking or serializable transaction)
Create lib/server/providers.ts - provider selection based on placeholder detection
Create middleware.ts using next-auth for route protection
Create app/page.tsx - public booking entry page showing available providers
Create app/auth/ - Auth.js sign-in/sign-up routes
Create app/dashboard/ - protected dashboard with provider availability management, booking list, payment status
Create app/api/webhooks/stripe/route.ts - Stripe webhook with raw body verification, idempotent processing, booking state update on payment confirmation
Create app/api/book/route.ts - booking creation with slot concurrency check and payment initiation
Create tests/unit/domain/policies.test.ts - authorization and booking state machine tests
Create tests/unit/server/billing.test.ts - Stripe fake adapter tests (payment-booking binding)
Create tests/unit/server/calendar.test.ts - Calendar fake adapter tests
Create tests/unit/server/mail.test.ts - Mail fake adapter tests
Create tests/integration/auth.test.ts - unauthenticated/unauthorized denial
Create tests/integration/booking.test.ts - concurrent slot reservation test, payment confirmation, cancellation consistency
Create tests/property/auth-consistency.test.ts - Property 4
Create tests/property/webhook-authenticity.test.ts - Property 5 (Stripe payment events)
Create tests/smoke/build.test.ts - build verification
Create .env.example with classified sections
Create README.md documenting booking flow, state machines, concurrency, schema, providers, tests, deployment
Add vitest.config.ts, tsconfig.json, eslint.config.mjs, postcss.config.mjs, next.config.ts, tailwind config
Run pnpm install to generate pnpm-lock.yaml
Verify: pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck, pnpm test, pnpm build all pass
Git commit all files on feat/nextjs-booking-saas branch
acceptance_criteria: nextjs-booking-saas/ directory exists at repo root with all Web SaaS blueprint files
starter.json matches catalog entry id:4 exactly
pnpm run test passes (including concurrency and state machine tests)
Booking/payment state machine maintains consistency: confirmed booking requires paid payment, cancelled payment preserves booking for compensation
Fake adapters activate with placeholder env values
Property tests use fast-check with at least 100 runs
Concurrent slot booking test prevents double-booking
verification: cd nextjs-booking-saas && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
